blocks.source: Vol IV, Policy Training, § Reinforcement Learning and Environment Interaction
blocks.md: When an archive lacks recovery demonstrations for a displaced strike plate, letting the robot discover a recovery on its own by trial and error means paying for every failed attempt in motor winding heat (WindingJouleHeat = int TorqueProducingCurrent(TimeInstant)^2 ElectricalResistance\,dTimeInstant), gearbox fatigue reversals, jammed latch cams, and human reset labor. Yet when expert corrections are unavailable or a task demands strategies no demonstrator can supply, closed-loop trial is the only way to generate experience in the states the learner's own actions reach.

questions.q: The section **Reinforcement Learning and Environment Interaction** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: The policy manifest records how a checkpoint was produced (regime sequence, base digest, inference contract, data support, omission log, wear log) and computes the declared ODD as support minus omissions.
Posing the task as an MDP makes the engineer-written reward and discount the whole objective, so the optimizer exploits any omitted or mismeasured term.
On-machine fine-tuning absorbs a measurable local mismatch but produces new weights whose earlier evaluations no longer apply, and a gated residual bounds where adaptation may act.
A velocity-commanded policy has a disturbance-rejecting loop beneath it and its error integrates once, while a torque-commanded policy's error integrates twice.
